p0.title: Puffy Heart Ball Chain Necklace
p0.descriptionHtml:
A bold puffed heart pendant on a chunky ball chain, polished to a mirror shine.

  • Stainless steel, plain silver-tone or gold-tone plated
  • Puffed heart pendant about 1.4 in tall; round beads about 5/16 in across
  • Extender chain at the clasp; also offered as a gold-tone bracelet

Necklace about 16 in + 2 in extender

p1.title: Pearl Daisy Chain Choker
p1.descriptionHtml:
A fine gold-tone chain set with five tiny daisies of pearl-look beads that sit close at the collarbone.

  • Copper with gold-tone plating
  • Five evenly spaced pearl-bead flowers with gold-tone centers on a fine cable chain
  • Lobster clasp and extender chain with a small charm at the end

Chain about 14 in + 2 in extender

p2.title: Oval Stone Curb Chain Choker
p2.descriptionHtml:
A chunky gold-tone curb chain choker centered on an oval cabochon stone framed by tiny rhinestones.

  • Stainless steel with gold-tone plating, rhinestone accents
  • Oval cabochon in green, red or cream set in a curved center bar
  • Curb chain about 0.2 in wide, extender chain at the clasp

Chain about 16 in + 2 in extender

p3.title: Embrace Figure Pendant Necklace
p3.descriptionHtml:
A small sculpted pendant of two figures wrapped in a hug, on a fine silver-tone chain.

  • Polished plated alloy, silver-tone with gold-tone or black accents
  • Couple design, or mother-and-child design with a smaller figure held
  • Pendant hangs from a small bail on a fine chain

One size · chain length not stated by the supplier

p4.title: Beaded Daisy Bracelet & Necklace
p4.descriptionHtml:
A dainty gold-tone chain dotted with faceted bead daisies and tiny gold-tone balls, as a bracelet or a matching necklace.

  • Gold-tone stainless steel chain with small faceted beads
  • Daisies in one color or mixed colors, little ball stations between them
  • Lobster clasp with an extender chain

Bracelet or necklace · lengths not stated by the supplier

p5.title: Zodiac Crescent Moon Necklace
p5.descriptionHtml:
A filigree crescent moon cradling a round domed pendant printed with a zodiac sign's constellation.

  • Silver-tone plated alloy with a domed cabochon over the print
  • Openwork swirl moon, sign name in small print, all 12 signs
  • Pendant about 1.6 in tall, cabochon about 0.8 in across

Chain about 18 in, lobster clasp
